mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases over three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS MoM > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of instances where PAYEMS MoM < -100,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL MoM > 0.5%.
